finalText:
Found the bug. The pricing engine was rounding too early.

When applying stacked coupons (a percent discount plus a flat one), the code rounded after each discount in USD, then converted and rounded again. This premature rounding lost precision and caused the cent-off errors, especially with non-USD currencies.

The fix: apply all discounts without intermediate rounding, convert to the target currency, then round exactly once at the end. This matches the reference implementation the tests expected.

All 40 tests pass now.
